title: customer_create_response
description: The response to the customer create action request.

customer_create_id.description: Riskified ID of the created customer.

decision.description:
The decision made by Riskified regarding the customer creation process.

**Possible values:**
- `allow`: Customer creation is approved
- `block`: Customer creation should be blocked

**Note:** "allow"/"block" response controlled by threshold set for `/customer_create` (threshold is applied to both sandbox and production).

decision_reason.description: The reason of the decision made by Riskified regarding the customer creation process.
